history.question: What does the supplier guarantee about the right to sell goods?
history.answer: The supplier guarantees a right to dispose of the property in the goods when ownership passes. [1]

results.answer:
In everyday language, the seller must have the legal right to sell you the goods when ownership passes to you. [1]

There is an exception when the deal makes clear, through the contract or its circumstances, that only whatever ownership rights the seller or another person has are being transferred. This particular guarantee also does not apply to hiring or leasing goods. [1]

evidence.title: Australian Consumer Law — s 51: Guarantee as to title
evidence.text: 51 Guarantee as to title 1 (1) If a person (the supplier) supplies goods to a consumer, there is a guarantee that the supplier will have a right to dispose of the property in the goods when that property is to pass to the consumer. 2 (2) Subsection (1) does not apply to a supply (a supply of limited title) if an intention that the supplier of the goods should transfer only such title as the supplier, or another person, may have: a appears from the contract for the supply; or b is to be inferred from the circumstances of that contract. 3 This section does not apply if the supply is a supply by way of hire or lease.

retrieved.title: Australian Consumer Law — s 56: Guarantee relating to the supply of goods by description
retrieved.section_heading: Guarantee relating to the supply of goods by description
retrieved.text: 56 Guarantee relating to the supply of goods by description 1 If: a a person supplies, in trade or commerce, goods by description to a consumer; and b the supply does not occur by way of sale by auction; there is a guarantee that the goods correspond with the description. 2 A supply of goods is not prevented from being a supply by description only because, having been exposed for sale or hire, they are selected by the consumer. 3 If goods are supplied by description as well as by reference to a sample or demonstration model, the guarantees in this section and in section 57 both apply.

Subdivision B—Guarantees relating to the supply of services
